label: POTENCY_1 under privation from unactualized capacity and capable-subject lack (inference)
rule: Substitute equivalent privation and lack of act under the retained capacity hypothesis
meaning: For the supplied potency predicate, the analysis F gives capacity and lack of act in the same respect. On precisely those capable subjects, Q exchanges lack of act for privation in either direction. This derives T. At the adopted function F is definitional. For an independently supplied predicate F is an explicit input.
